first_order: noticing WSU missing while others have logos up
author: azimir
text: Reddit's April Fools event involves collaboratively drawing on a 1000x1000 pixel wall. Basically, people are collaboratively doing graffiti. Many countries, states, organizations, and universities have logos and pictures up. I haven't seen any WSU logos up there.
note: The speaker describes the canvas and the absence they see.

first_order: putting WSU on the map with a grey-on-red design
author: azimir
text: I'm going a simple WSU (grey on red) at about (437, 864) in case anyone's interested in putting us on the map.
note: The speaker announces a design and coordinates while inviting participation.

first_order: adding a grey dot to help with the crimson and grey
author: hp12324
text: Checked that place just moments ago, and couldn't see any kind of WSU there, so I added a grey dot in that general area. Hope that helps with the crimson and grey :)
note: The reply reports checking and placing a pixel in response to the announced design.

first_order: thanking help and reporting the W done
author: azimir
text: Thank you. I'm working away on things. W is done. S finished soon.
note: The initiator acknowledges help and gives a progress update.

first_order: reporting people drew over the work
author: azimir
text: Ah well, a bunch of people ran through and drew over my work.
note: The speaker reports the attempted design being overwritten.

first_order: cheering the good effort after it was drawn over
author: hp12324
text: Take my upvote for the good effort though. Go cougs!
note: The reply recognizes the failed effort rather than claiming a canvas action.

first_order: directing the asker to news that the work was drawn over
author: hp12324
text: See azimir's next post. Other people drew over azimir's work.
note: The reply answers the location request by pointing to the overwrite report.

first_order: saying a shroom crew came through and the half-finished design vanished
author: azimir
text: Yeah, it was about halfway done around (437,864), but a crew came through and put up the shroom. I couldn't keep up, so it's all vanished.
note: The speaker answers the location question with coordinates and an account of losing the work.

first_order: starting a small WSU above the RWBY sign
author: SuperTeddyGuy
text: Well... Its no Cougar head but Im working on a small writing of "WSU" on around (878,547), right on top of RWBY sign. I just started and I was thinking on something like this:
note: A second participant proposes a smaller design and locates it.

first_order: asking for help with the small WSU
author: SuperTeddyGuy

first_order: asking for an upper-left coordinate to align with the layout
author: azimir
text: That's a pretty contested area. Do you have the coordinate of the upper left pixel of your design? that way I can align directly with your layout.
note: The reply identifies a constraint and requests a precise coordinate for alignment.

first_order: choosing an area that won't trigger a war and giving the upper-left pixel
author: SuperTeddyGuy
text: Thats one of the only few areas that wont trigger a war with anyone. Upper Left would be 877,545
note: The speaker explains the site choice in their own terms and supplies the coordinate.

first_order: promising to check the design tomorrow morning
author: azimir
text: I'll definitely check in on this tomorrow morning.
note: The speaker commits to returning to the attempt.

first_order: leaving the design overnight to sleep for classes
author: azimir
text: Gotta get some sleep for classes and such at this point.
note: The speaker says why participation stops for the night.
